described_as: The owner's mixed folder. A sorting agent divides it into piles in a private repository; this agent reads the pile for the Duska line and the pile for both lines (rulings X-019, X-020). At private commit 2e9dd04 the Duska pile was empty and the shared pile held one file. The pile is the sorter's label: a prior, not evidence. At private commit 4f16658 the Duska pile held four files: a gravestone photograph, a marriage register page of 1892, a screenshot of the Senné baptism register in an online viewer, and a page of burials of 1831 to 1841. At b9e7b06 three more: a census household (image kept), a page from an online family tree (held unopened) and a newspaper print of 1911 (held; transcribed in part). At 31b6cf5 one more: a cemetery record of a Duska born 28 Nov 1890.

Given in four parts as 'Inacovce - Reformed Catholic', 45 files. The owner called the fourth part final. Baptism entries from a Reformed (Calvinist) register for Solymos, the Hungarian name of Iňačovce, 1825 to 1921. Whether it sits under 'Duska Baptisms' on his desktop was not said.
Given as 'Presov - Greek Catholic FULL', 4 files. Baptisms from the Greek Catholic parish of Eperjes (Prešov), 1804 to 1822, in Latin. No Duska.

Given in eight parts as 'Senne - Roman Catholic', 95 image files, with one text document that is held unopened. Closed by this agent on the owner's word to judge as it saw fit: his file names run from 'Andras' to 'Zsuzsanna' and end with the volume's first page. Baptism entries from the Roman Catholic register of Senné (Szenna; Ungszenna by 1906), 1866 to 1912.
One image strip, marked '[full]' by the owner: the baptism of an Anna Krak at Sztára (Staré) in January 1848.

Announced by the owner as 'Beginning Duska Census'. Part 1, '1767 - Urbanarium': eight images of urbarial tables for Solymos (three pages, one of them twice), Szenna (two pages), Csicser and Viszoka (one page each), with one word-processor file held unopened. More parts are expected. Part 2, '1869 Solymos Census Full': four census household sheets as photographs of a screen, four screenshots of them, and six files not published (four compiled pages unopened; a third party's transcription; the archive file).
